notes.title: Update 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Addressed various minor bugs to enhance the overall gameplay experience.
[*] Resolved clipping issues.
[*] Fixed instances where players could get stuck in certain areas.
[*] Made ducks hittable from previously unreachable spots.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Reworded certain in-game phrases for improved clarity.
[/list]
